section: Reservation detail — guest and contract panel
context: Back-office page showing one reservation. The panel is read-only until the user clicks Edit, which swaps it for a form. Project is Next.js App Router with Ant Design 5.

candidates.Table: Many records of the same shape, one row each, with column headers, sorting or pagination.
candidates.Descriptions: One record's fields as label/value pairs. No headers, no rows, no sorting.
candidates.Card: A titled container that groups other content. Carries no data semantics of its own.
candidates.Tag: A short status or category word rendered as a coloured chip.
candidates.Drawer: A panel sliding in from an edge, over the page, dismissed without leaving it.
candidates.Modal: A centred dialog that blocks the page until confirmed or cancelled.
candidates.Select: Choose one of many options from a collapsed dropdown list.
candidates.Radio.Group: Choose one of a few options, all visible at once.
